entities.summary: Matteo Gamba was a performers & entertainers in Bergamo (b. 1979-10-19, Bergamo) who made significant contributions during the Contemporary era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
